'''Giorgio Picci''' (26 May 1942 – 11 March 2026) was an Italian electrical engineer and control theorist. He made widely recognized contributions to the field of [[Control Theory|Systems and Control]], and in particular, to the areas of Stochastic Realization and [[system identification|System Identification]]. He had also been a pioneer in [[computer vision|Computer Vision]].<ref>{{cite book |last1=Finesso |first1=Lorenzo |last2=Spreij |first2=Peter |editor-first1=Alessandro |editor-last1=Chiuso|editor-first2=Augusto|editor-last2=Ferrante|editor-first3=Stefano |editor-last3=Pinzoni |date=24 October 2007 |title=Modeling, Estimation and Control: Festschrift in Honor of Giorgio Picci on the Occasion of his Sixty-Fifth Birthday|series=Lecture Notes in Control and Information Sciences |volume=364 |url=https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-3-540-73570-0 |location=Berlin, Heidelberg |publisher=Springer |page= XXVI, 356 |doi=10.1007/978-3-540-73570-0 |arxiv=0704.2208 |isbn=978-3-540-73570-0 |access-date=8 February 2025}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://bittanti.faculty.polimi.it/VENEZIA2007.html|title=sergio bittanti memorabilia: people &#124; Celebrating 65-th birthday of Giorgio Picci in Venice at Marzollo's}}</ref> He published a monograph (in English)<ref name="LP_Book_2015">{{cite book |first1=Anders|last1=Lindquist|first2=Giorgio|last2=Picci|date=24 April 2015 |title=Linear Stochastic Systems: A Geometric Approach to Modeling, Estimation and Identification|url=https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-3-662-45750-4 |location=Berlin, Heidelberg |publisher=Springer |page= XV, 781 |doi=10.1007/978-3-662-45750-4 |isbn=978-3-662-45750-4 |access-date=8 February 2025}}</ref> and nearly 200 papers in these areas.

He was a Professor [[Emeritus]] with the Department of Information Engineering, [[University of Padova|University of Padua]], Italy.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://automatica.dei.unipd.it/people/#|title=Automatica &#124; People}}</ref> He was also the Italian director of the [[Confucius Institute]] at the University of Padua,<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.istitutoconfuciopadova.it/drupal/en/content/staff|title=Staff &#124; Istituto Confucio di Padova|website=www.istitutoconfuciopadova.it}}</ref> where he actively promoted cultural and scientific exchanges between China and Italy,<ref>Multiple sources: 
* For cultural exchanges, see e.g., the Chinese news reports {{Cite web|url=https://sports.tom.com/201802/3371789262.html|title="一带一路"中国太极文化世界行威尼斯站完美收官|website=sports.tom.com}}, and {{Cite web|url=https://news.gzhu.edu.cn/info/1002/27607.htm|title=帕多瓦大学孔子学院外方院长荣获孔子学院院长纪念奖章-广州大学新闻网|website=news.gzhu.edu.cn}}.
* For scientific exchanges, see e.g., the Chinese news reports {{Cite web|url=https://news.gzhu.edu.cn/info/1002/10712.htm|title=意大利帕多瓦大学孔子学院意方院长在我校讲学-广州大学新闻网|website=news.gzhu.edu.cn}}, {{Cite web|url=https://mci.hubu.edu.cn/info/1041/11893.htm|title=意大利帕多瓦大学Giorgio Picci教授应邀为我院学生开展学术讲座-数统学院|website=mci.hubu.edu.cn}}, and {{Cite web|url=https://news.cri.cn/20190309/fe89c6f9-6a59-b5c5-4349-f8c51b1622ee.html|title=意大利科学家点赞政府工作报告扩大国际创新合作内容|website=news.cri.cn}}.

ANTONELLA PRIGIONI|website=www.youtube.com|date=10 February 2016 }}, {{Cite web|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tm2OgN8n-UQ|title=Intervista Giorgio Picci &#124; 21 Settembre 2018|website=www.youtube.com|date=28 September 2018 }}, and {{Cite web|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kFA6eTcmrO0|title=Intervista a Giorgio Picci &#124; 4 Febbraio 2019|website=www.youtube.com|date=9 February 2019 }}.
</ref> in collaborations with [[Guangzhou University]] in China.

== Biography ==

Picci obtained the [[Doctor of Engineering|Doctor in Engineering]] (Dr. Eng.) degree (''[[summa cum laude]]'') from the University of Padua in 1967. From 1980 to 2012, he was the [[Chair (academic)|Chair]] Professor in [[System Identification]] at the Department of Information Engineering, University of Padua. During his career, he had a number of visiting positions with different universities on three [[continents]], namely [[North America]] (the [[United States]]), [[Europe]] (the [[Netherlands]], [[Austria]], and [[Sweden]]), and [[Asia]] ([[Japan]] and [[China]]).<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.dei.unipd.it/~picci/|title=Giorgio Picci's Homepage|website=www.dei.unipd.it}}</ref>

Picci was a [[Fellow of the IEEE]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ieeecss.org/archive/css-ieee-fellows#93|title=CSS IEEE Fellows Archive &#124; IEEE Control Systems Society|website=ieeecss.org}}</ref> a foreign member of the [[Royal Swedish Academy of Engineering Sciences]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.iva.se/en/fellows-of-iva/b0992197-48ce-e511-80c7-00155d018517/giorgio-picci/|title=Ledamot|website=www.iva.se}}</ref> a Fellow of the [[International Federation of Automatic Control]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ifac-control.org/awards/ifac-fellows|title=IFAC Fellows — IFAC · International Federation of Automatic Control|website=www.ifac-control.org}}</ref>
and a member of the [[Accademia Galileiana|Galilean Academy of Sciences, Letters and Arts in Padua]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.accademiagalileiana.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=104:classe-di-scienze-matematiche-e-naturali&catid=117&Itemid=593|title=Classe di Scienze Matematiche e Naturali|date=October 25, 2024|website=www.accademiagalileiana.it}}</ref>

Picci died on the morning of 11 March 2026, at the age of 83.
